Latest press releases
African Union Development Agency and Sightsavers join forces to fight neglected diseases
The partnership will unite AUDA-NEPAD’s leadership and convening power with Sightsavers’ technical expertise in NTD elimination, disability inclusion and community-centred health programmes.
Global leaders urged to accelerate investment in eye care to generate billions in economic benefits
This World Sight Day (8 October), Sightsavers is calling on governments, donors, private and public sectors to integrate eye care into health systems, boost investment and service access.
Turn promises into action, campaigners urge world leaders ahead of third global disability summit in Berlin
The United Nations’ 2030 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) will not be met unless world leaders take concrete action on disability rights at a major summit this April, campaigners have warned.
Global health milestone as Pakistan becomes 19th country to eliminate blinding trachoma
Sightsavers commends Pakistan following the World Health Organization (WHO) announcement yesterday that it has become the nineteenth country to eliminate blinding trachoma as a public health problem.
Art speaks louder: four-city mural campaign challenges world leaders on disability rights
A series of murals have been unveiled in major cities around the world carrying a similar message: persons with disabilities must not be left behind in the fight to end global poverty.
